Cleveland's most recent game was a 27-24 win over Houston on Nov. 15, bringing the Browns to 6-4.
Cleveland had its Week 11 bye before hosting Las Vegas.
The Browns entered with a 4-0 home record.

excerpts:
The NFL has flexed the [Las Vegas Raiders](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/lv/las-vegas-raiders) \- [Cleveland Browns](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/cle/cleveland-browns) Week 12 game into NBC's "Sunday Night Football" slot, the league announced Tuesday.

The Nov. 29 matchup will replace the previously scheduled [New England Patriots](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/ne/new-england-patriots) \- [Los Angeles Chargers](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/lac/los-angeles-chargers) game, which will move to the 4:05 p.m. ET slot.

Instead, Cleveland will host Las Vegas in a primetime game that will have huge implications in the AFC playoff race.
